name: hotel-finder-root
description: Hotel Finder using Temporal Workflows - Full-Stack Application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,WORKER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
